rationale: Self-review changes the primary family from QUBO to Grover. Bind only its first explicit alternative: earlier strict-greater and later at-least comparisons, with no finite admission guard. Its second iterative maximum-finding alternative remains unspecified, and the QUBO alternative remains an unconstructed sketch. A refutation of this explicit predicate would not refute those other alternatives or prove whole-task failure.

interpretations.meaning: Explicit first Grover alternative with earlier > and later >=.
interpretations.expression: all(values[i] > values[j] for j in indices if j < i) and all(values[i] >= values[k] for k in indices if k > i)
